parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Obtain $\operatorname{Re}z\geq2$. B1. Allow $2\leq\operatorname{Re}(z)\leq3$. Condone strict inequalities throughout part (a). The shading is to the right-hand side of the diagram. Obtain an answer of the form $|z-a|\leq b$. M1. Accept an equation or any inequality sign; $a$ must be complex and $b$ real; condone brackets in place of modulus for this mark. Obtain $|z-1+2i|\leq2$. A1 OE; $|z-(1-2i)|\leq2$. Total: [3]

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Identify the correct point. B1; it may be clearly indicated on the diagram, may be $(2,-\sqrt3-2)$, or may be found by attempting to solve $(x-1)^2+(y+2)^2=2^2$ with $x=2$. Carry out a correct method for finding the least value of $\arg z$. M1. Obtain $-61.8°$ or $298.2°$, or $-1.08$ radians or $5.2(0)$ radians. A1. Total: [3]
